ios.desc:
Improve your running cadence, maintain consistent pacing, and reduce the risk of injury with Runo.

Whether you’re a beginner or marathon runner, Runo helps you run smarter with rhythmic audio tailored to your pace.

Listen to your favorite podcasts, or audiobooks while keeping perfect cadence:  Runo runs in the background and blends into your workout, no interruptions, just better performance.


WHY YOU’LL BE THRILLED WITH RUNO:

1) Customize your steps per minute (SPM), find your rythm!

2) Improve form and efficiency with cadence training

3) Prevent overstriding and reduce fatigue

4) Minimal, distraction free interface

5) Perfect for interval training, tempo runs, and long distance workouts

6) Apple Watch Support


WHY CADENCE MATTERS FOR RUNNERS: 

Studies show that an optimal cadence can improve your running economy, help prevent injuries, and make you a more efficient runner. 
Runo makes it simple.

Download Runo — your go to cadence trainer — and experience the rhythm of better running.

Privacy Policy: https://runoapp.com/privacy-policy.html 

Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Lovingly created by two runners, for runners everywhere.

quotes.text: I like to run and listen to podcasts or audiobooks at the same time, but realized that my pace was slower than usual. So I created this metronome that helps me improve my pace and keep it 180 spm. It's quite simple but effective.
